A ⇒ B fails genuinely: abstract setting, and even on the embedded SU(n) A has no curvature statement (i), no eigenbasis-independent count (ii), nothing for t ≥ 1 (A's multiplicities live on γ|[0,1]); B's conjMultAt (Jacobi fields on [0,t]) vs the project's conjMultiplicity (Jacobi fields on [0,1] vanishing at 0, t) needs an extension/restriction dictionary not in the project. B ⇒ A fails genuinely: B has no explicit Jacobi fields (suSol_ode, isJacobiField_suJac, covAlong_suJac_zero) and nothing for non-integer a or general index types.
